definitions.explanation: Refers to something that has already been mentioned or discussed earlier in a text or speech. A formal, written-style expression commonly used in academic papers, reports, and official documents.

examples.japanese: {前述|ぜんじゅつ}のとおりである。
{前述|ぜんじゅつ}した{問題|もんだい}について{検討|けんとう}する。
examples.english: We will examine the issue mentioned earlier.

examples.japanese: {前述|ぜんじゅつ}の{理由|りゆう}から、この{計画|けいかく}は{中止|ちゅうし}とすることにした。
examples.english: For the aforementioned reasons, we decided to cancel this plan.

notes:
A formal, written-style word. Rarely used in casual conversation. Typically found in essays, reports, academic papers, and official documents.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{前述|ぜんじゅつ} — aforementioned (formal, written)
・{上記|じょうき} — above-mentioned (more common in documents with visual layout)
・{先述|せんじゅつ} — previously stated (synonym, slightly less common)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{前述|ぜんじゅつ}の〜 (the aforementioned ~)
・{前述|ぜんじゅつ}のとおり (as mentioned above)
・{前述|ぜんじゅつ}した〜 (the previously stated ~)
